svg.title: Minimization under a + b ≥3 gives min g(a)g(b) = 19 · 23 = 437, at profiles (1, 2) or (2, 1). The alternatives (0, 3), (3, 0) cost at least 486; (2, 2) costs at least 529; all other allowed profiles are higher. Equation (39) proves the long-horizon bound. For completeness the short-horizon counting retains the labels, not just rank sums. Consider (a, b) = (1, 2), put h = |A ∩B| ∈{0, 1}, and let k /∈B. The old forced pairs yield R2 ≥46 + h2 and R3 ≥138 + 2h. The new faithful Fjk adds at least sjk ≥2 at horizon two.
